sources.title: Tiiny - Portable And Powerful Local AI
sources.snippet: Tiiny is a portable local‑AI device for running offline agents and downloading models—one‑time purchase with no subscription or token fees, no internet needed.

sources.title: Tiny Model Generator | AI Models That Run on CPU
sources.snippet: Need an AI model that runs on CPU, without a GPU, or on cheap hardware? Tiny Model Generator creates custom small AI models for narrow tasks that run locally, privately, and affordably.
